It does not reconstruct the studied Al-Cr-Fe-Ni multilayers, the 8–80 nm modulation-period series, or the special behavior of the 16 nm semicoherent sample. The target mechanism involves dislocation blocking and pileup at semicoherent FCC/BCC interfaces, with proposed stress-induced interfacial amorphization enabling atomic diffusion or interface slip. The generated TiC mechanism is speculative, operates under different conditions, and predicts the opposite transition.
